title: Test table
subject: Computing
unit: Spring 1: Selection in physical computing and Secure Your Secrets
source: Seeded from computing/y5 lesson 8 (Test table (pupil PDF))
intro: Lesson 8: Selection with sensors. To understand how a sensor reading and a condition decide what a device does

questions.q: Build the night light and test with the slider.
questions.a: forever: if light level < 50 then show icon else clear screen.
questions.model: Teacher builds it, then tests at 10 (icon shows), at 50 (clear, as 50 is not less than 50), and at 200 (clear).

questions.a: So the micro:bit keeps checking the light, not just once.

questions.q: Core: Make a temperature warning: if temperature > 25 show a sun icon, else show a tick. Test with the slider.
questions.a: forever: if temperature > 25 then show icon (sun-like) else show icon (tick).
questions.model: Teacher swaps the light block for the temperature block in the night light script.

questions.q: Extend: Write a test table: three temperatures, what you expect, what happened.
questions.a: For example 20: tick, tick; 26: sun, sun; 25: tick, tick.

questions.q: Stretch: Explain why 25 is a sensible threshold for a 'too warm' room.
questions.a: Most rooms feel comfortable around 18 to 22 °C; above about 25 °C feels too warm.

questions.q: A street light uses which sensor? A) temperature B) light C) button

questions.a: The value where the decision changes.
